editorial_validation_note: Replaced C0065 and C0070 because the SAE generic chassis code table reserves those codes; substituted documented generic C006A and C0072. Never publish an SAE-reserved code as if it had a generic definition.

editorial_photography_gate.required: Ten original photorealistic 1600x900 WebP featured photos depicting relevant real-workshop scenes. AI-image-generated photographs may be used when technically plausible; Pillow-drawn shapes are forbidden. Check model/sensor plausibility, photo realism, duplicate reuse, featured_media and og:image before declaring release.

editorial_video_gate.required: Only embed a video if title/channel/content relevance and embeddability have been checked. Verify working player on the public page post-publish. If no sufficiently relevant licensed video exists, record honest absence and never insert a random video.
